Name: Springmyst - Enchantments of Yore
Author: Arleau
Description:
[size=6][font=bebas_neuebook]What this is[/font][/size]

This mod replaces vanilla weapon enchantments with an entirely new and significantly more interesting collection. It also adds a few slingshot-exclusive enchantments and tweaks to tool enchantments.

In addition, this mod optionally replaces the generic vanilla "Forged" text in weapon tooltips with actual configurable gemstone sockets.


[font=bebas_neuebook][size=6]Melee Weapon Enchantments[/size][/font]

[list]
[*][b]Carving:[/b] Attacks on-hit reduce enemy defense by 1 point (continuing below zero). Armored enemies (i.e., Armored Bugs and shelled Rock Crabs) lose their armor when their defense is reduced to zero.
[*][b]Cleaving:[/b] Attacks on-hit spread 60% - 20% (based on distance) of the damage to other enemies around the target.
[*][b]Explosive:[/b] Absorbs and stores the damage from enemy hits (before mitigation). The next special move releases twice the accumulated damage as an explosion.
[*][b]Energized:[/b] Moving and attacking generates energy, up to 100 stacks. At maximum stacks, the next attack causes a powerful electric
discharge which deals heavy damage in a large area.[*][b]Greedy:[/b] Attacks that would leave an enemy below 10% max health immediately execute the enemy, converting the remaining health into gold. Each consecutive takedown increases this threshold by 1%, resetting when you take damage.*
[*][b]Radiant:[/b] Weapon swings create a mid-range sunlight projectile which blinds enemies upon collision. +50% damage to shadow and undead monsters and prevents them from resurrecting.
[*][b]Reckless:[/b] Replaces the defensive parry special move with a stabbing lunge attack. [b]Sword only[/b].
[*][b]Sanguine:[/b] Enemy takedowns recover some health proportional to the enemy's max health. Excess healing is converted into a shield for up to 20% of the player's max health, which slowly decays after not dealing or taking damage for 15s.
[*][b]Wabbajack:[/b] Causes unpredictable effects.**
[/list][spoiler][size=2]
* Hard caps at 1000 HP. To prevent cheesing boss monsters from expansion mods, this is implemented as a percentage chance per hit, with the chance being near-zero close to the 1000 HP hard cap and near 100% for regular monsters.
** Example effects: execute or fully-heal the enemy; apply a random [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24332]debuff[/url]; grow or shrink the enemy; split the enemy in two; transform enemy into a random animal; transform the enemy into a random amount of cheese.[/size][/spoiler]

[font=bebas_neuebook][size=6]Slingshot Enchantments[/size][/font]

[list]
[*][b]Energized:[/b] Moving and shooting generates energy, up to 100 stacks. At maximum stacks, the next shot carries an electric charge, which discharges dealing heavy area damage when it hits an enemy.
[*][b]Chilling:[/b] Progressively chills enemies on hit for 2 seconds, freezing after stacking 3 times.
[*][b]Echoing:[/b] Summons two "echoes" of the fired projectile, that auto-aim at the nearest enemy after a short delay. Only works when enemies are nearby.*
[*][b]Quincy:[/b] Attacks fire an energy projectile if no ammo is equipped. The projectile is stronger at lower health. Only works when enemies are
nearby.**[/list][spoiler][size=2]
[size=2]* Echo projectiles inherit 60% of the main projectile's damage.[/size]
** Quincy projectiles have no knockback. Damage increase by 50% below 2/3 max health, and again to by 100% when below 1/3 (the projectile will change color to reflect this). If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk Of Life[/url] is installed and the player has the Rascal profession, Quincy projectiles can be fired even if a different ammo is equipped in the second ammo slot. If the player also has the Desperado profession, the Quincy projectile's size will be increased proportionally by overcharge [b]instead of[/b] its velocity and knockback.
[/spoiler]

[font=bebas_neuebook][size=6]Tool Enchantments[/size][/font]

[list]
[*][size=2][b]Master:[/b] [s]Fishing Level +1[/s] Increases the corresponding skill level by 20%. Can now be applied to Axe, Pickaxe, Hoe and Watering Can.*[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Swift:[/b] Can now be applied to Watering Can.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Reaching:[/b] Can now be applied to Iridium Scythe (increases the area of effect instead of adding a charge level).[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Haymaker:[/b] Can now be applied to Iridium Scythe [b]only[/b].[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Sharp: [/b]Can be applied to Iridium Scythe and Pickaxe. Grants increased damage versus enemies.**[/size]
[/list][spoiler]
* [/size]Axe -> Foraging Level, Pickaxe -> Mining Level, Hoe & Watering Can -> Farming Level.[size=2]
** Iridium Scythe gains damage equivalent to a Galaxy Sword. Iridium Pickaxe gains damage equivalent to a Galaxy Hammer.
[/spoiler]

[/size][font=bebas_neuebook][size=6]Jade Rebalance[/size][/font]

The Jade enchantment is useless in vanilla; it provides the exact same damage increase as the Ruby enchantment, but only to critical strikes. So to make it
viable we give it a small buff:

[b]Jade Enchantment: [/b][i]Critical hit damage [s]+10%[/s] +50%.

[/i]With this, the Jade enchantment becomes stronger than the Ruby enchantment at around 20% critical hit chance.


[font=bebas_neuebook][size=6]Uninstalling[/size][/font]

Before uninstalling this mod, [b]you must remove all enchantments from your existing weapons[/b] and save the game.[b] Failure to do so may brick your save file.[/b]
